'''2009 Worlds Day 2 Nick Jones DS No Money, No Parts, No Deal!''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Nick Jones]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[No Money, No Parts, No Deal! / You're A Slave?]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
